name: KNOWIN
summary: KNOWIN develops embodied intelligent systems for consumer homes. These systems have a physical form and support continuous interaction in real environments through a perception–generation–execution–evolution loop. Using independently developed full-stack technology, a new generative embodied foundation-model system and an innovative synthetic-data approach, the company aims to improve robots' generalization across complex home environments, reliable execution of long task sequences and dependable delivery. It addresses modern households' needs for companionship, interaction, entertainment and help with frequent household tasks, offering more intelligent, autonomous and convenient home services.
